author: Y Combinator
description:
For the first time ever, we're bringing Startup School to Bangalore this April.

Hear from founders Harshil Mathur of Razorpay, Vidit Aatrey of Meesho, Lalit Keshre of Groww, Mukund Jha of Emergent, and more.

And join the best builders and hackers from across the country for a day of talks and sessions with YC partners.

Register now at https://events.ycombinator.com/yc-sus-india.
title: Startup School is coming to India! 🇮🇳
